category: email marketing sender and campaign API

free_tier.stated: Free forever: 12,000 emails per month to 1,000 contacts, no credit card required
free_tier.notes: This is the Marketing Platform free plan. The platform also sells a separate Email API for transactional sending from USD 10/month, opened by a 14-day free trial with 100 emails per signup and no card; the two products are billed separately.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an outbound email sender

retention.stated: unverified: the free Marketing Platform plan's activity retention period is not stated on the first-party pricing page
retention.notes: The paid Email API states 7 days of activity retention on Basic and 30 days on Pro, but no retention figure is published for the free Marketing Platform plan.

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound email sender; the free tier's 12,000 monthly sends are counted, not billed per GB

interface_detail: the Marketing API at cloudapi.mailercloud.com/v1 (campaigns, contacts, lists, segments, webhooks, automations), plus the web app; a separate Email API at email-api.mailercloud.com handles transactional sends on paid plans
tooling: any HTTP client against the Marketing API with an API key in the Authorization header; the web app sends campaigns and automations
chaining: a 12,000-send monthly free sender driven from the Marketing API or web app, with a 50 request per second per-IP shaping on the API; pair it with the paid Email API when transactional sends are needed

limits.value: 12,000 emails per month on the free Marketing Platform plan
1,000 contacts on the free Marketing Platform plan
50 requests per second per client IP, sliding one-second window, on the Marketing API

binding_note: 12,000 sends a month to 1,000 contacts is the first ceiling a free sender reaches; the 50 request-per-second per-IP shaping then binds on the Marketing API

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for first name, last name, email, a phone number with a country selector, and a password; Google and Microsoft single sign-on are offered as alternatives. No card is required at signup. Sending needs a verified sender domain.

reliability_note: The Marketing API shapes requests per client IP; exceeding 50 per second returns HTTP 429 with no Retry-After header, so clients must back off on their own. No public read path exists for an outbound sender, so no probe was run.
confidence_note: Quota, identity, interface and limits come from first-party pricing, signup and API pages. No send was made, so delivery is not measured; a measured rung would need an account and a send.

evidence.quote: Yes. The Free plan is free forever with 12,000 emails a month to 1,000 contacts, and no credit card is required to start.
evidence.proved: the free Marketing Platform plan is free forever, allows 12,000 emails a month to 1,000 contacts, and needs no card
the comparison table confirms the 12,000 monthly send ceiling on the free plan
the comparison table confirms the 1,000 contact ceiling on the free plan

evidence.quote: Requests are rate-limited per client IP using a sliding one-second window of **50 requests per second** (higher limits can be arranged for specific IPs — contact support).
evidence.proved: the Marketing API shapes requests per client IP at 50 per second in a sliding one-second window

evidence.quote: The API does not currently send `X-RateLimit-*` or `Retry-After` headers. Clients — especially AI agents doing batch work — should treat any `429` as a signal to back off exponentially rather than expecting a server-provided retry time.
evidence.proved: a 429 carries no server-provided retry time, so clients must implement their own backoff

notes: A free-forever Marketing Platform sender with a 12,000 monthly send ceiling and a 50 request-per-second per-IP shaping on its REST API. The separate transactional Email API is a 14-day trial with 100 emails, not a free-forever tier. Free-plan activity retention is not published.
